experiment: Native AdamW augmented digit MNIST120epochs; complete epoch records
schedule: Same as Fashion augmented arm: 5-epoch warmup to0.001; cosine to0.0001 at fixedepoch120. Identical schedule and25800updates for each seed.

native_adamw.explicit_decay: Same prior native baseline: all parameters multiplied by (1-1e-5*factor)^(actual_batch_size/256); torch AdamW weight_decay=0 to avoid double decay. At full B256 equals WD .01 decoupled AdamW.

augmentation.method: training-only zero-padded translations up to2pixels with probability0.5

pairing: Two independent seeds33001/33002. Same seeds, initialization rule, minibatch order rule, schedule and augmentation recipe as the Fashion augmented arm. Within this experiment there is one condition, not an augmentation comparison.
data: Original MNIST55000/5000/10000 split and pixels/255, exact original MNIST data hashes. Test set previously used in earlier MNIST experiments.
primary: Within each nativeAdamW trajectory: FC1/FC2 alpha, distance to2 and sub2 deficit over0–120epochs; fixed endpoint120. Report20→60→120 changes in accuracy and CE.
secondary: FC3 native/smallN exploratory, hidden mean/capped/parameter-weighted/harmonic alpha, ECE15/Brier, layer norms/tail support, fixed-rank alpha20%/50%, complete gradient/update records and LR/step accounting.
test_access: Evaluate EVERY saved epoch0–120 only AFTER that trajectory completes120; no test feedback to training. No selection. Validation and raw spectra everyepoch.
selection: No early stopping, alpha target, best-validation selection, tuning, or automatic extension. Scientific nulls and functional failures retained.
uncertainty: Only2independent seeds. Show both individuals, mean/range and within-run changes; no confirmatory significance claim, no epoch/layer-as-replicate intervals.
spectral_support: Default hidden-layer WeightWatcher fits with raw spectra, xmin/tail count/KS and >=50evals,>=20tail,KS<=.2 sensitivity; no alpha-targeted cutoff. FC3 has only10correlated eigenvalues, native and direct smallN estimates exploratory.
late_training_interpretation: A120epoch diagnostic, not an asymptotic convergence test. Time and LRannealing co-vary. No claim that optimizer bias disappears; alpha>=2 differs from alpha close to2.
queue: Reuses campaign concurrency lock to avoid overlapping experiment training. No active training at setup.

fc3_estimator.method: WWFit.fit_powerlaw_smallN called directly; J selection preserved
fc3_estimator.uncertainty: 10 correlated eigenvalues; correction is not proof of accurate tail exponent

logging: Every epoch: full train/validation CE+accuracy, spectra and alpha, model+optimizer+RNG checkpoint; every minibatch: loss, gradient/moment/update norms and directions; test/calibration every saved epoch evaluated after all training updates.
